decisions.reason: The firm has invested heavily in the popular Demeter range and publicly committed to it, so it will keep the yogurt to justify the sunk costs and maintain the brand direction.
Launched only in 2024 with a dedicated website page, the mild sliced cheese represents recent investment and public commitment, so disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary causes.
Like the mild cheese, the sliced butter cheese is a recent launch with its own page, so the firm will persist to avoid wasting the investment and to allow the product time to gain traction.
